Data

Most origin-of-life data is open; the data that would confirm a route does not exist yet

We list 92 datasets: 13 we made, 67 public sets anyone can fetch, 2 sample collections on request and 10 that are cited but not reusable. We opened 86 of them at their DOI, API or landing page on 18 Nov 2026. 21 feed our results today.

05Missing

Missing, and wanted

No archive holds the measurements that would confirm or close a route, because nobody has made them. If you hold any of these, the Contribute page says how to share them.

  • Yields and rates for each prebiotic step run on the previous step's crude output, not on purified inputs. This decides whether any route runs end to end.
  • Any per-cycle measurement of a replicator whose copies outgrow its decay. QT45 shrinks by about half per cycle on its own numbers.
  • QT45 double-mutant fitness, which our sealed prediction (task #12) is waiting for.
  • A non-enumerated abiotic reference set: formula lists from meteorite and spark-discharge mass spectrometry. Schmitt-Kopplin 2010 has no deposit.
  • A downloadable prebiotic reaction network. NOEL and the Wołos 2020 network can only be browsed; KEGG and MetaCyc need a subscription.
  • Harmonised compound-abundance tables for Bennu and Ryugu. The instrument data are open but raw, tens of GB per bundle.
  • Any open dataset on vesicles or membranes under prebiotic conditions, and one open compilation of banded-iron and stromatolite records. We found neither.

Not verified: noel, jirasek2024, mineral_evolution, bennu_nasa_request, metbull, sgp. Each catalogue row says why.

06Get it

One file lists them all; one script fetches what we use

  • catalog.csvEvery row, with how it was checked · 27 KB

In the repository, python3 -I datasets/fetch.py list prints the catalogue and fetch <id> downloads a subset into datasets/local/. Downloads stay under 1.5 GB in total. Nothing third-party is republished here.

Goal: Map and test every route to the origin of life, by 2027

An open research project run by a human lead and a team of AI agents. Every result can be rerun from code.
